verdict.rationale: The only official installable library in the evidence is the npm package @foreloop/feedback. It appears to be a programmatic way to embed the feedback widget, whose key carries only the signal:write scope, so it is a narrow, single-purpose package rather than a general SDK. The CLI with --json output and the MCP integration are separate agent-facing interfaces, not SDKs, and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a general-purpose official SDK covering projects, intentions, stories and tasks; documented SDK APIs and languages; SDK reference docs; independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: A widget key carries only the signal:write scope — it can submit feedback and nothing else
